x-openregister._seedDataNote: Schemas only. A register.d fragment declares no objects; the example sets live in lib/Settings/profiles/.

_comment: ADR-037 register fragment, change agenda-change-notices-reach-members (REQ-ACN-003, REQ-ACN-004, matrix row age-18, issue #1381). A member can switch agenda notices off like the other notices, and a meeting remembers when each member last got an agenda change notice, so a burst of edits sends one.

agendaChanged.title: Agenda published or changed
agendaChanged.description: Notify when the agenda of a meeting you take part in is published, revised or changed.

agendaNoticeSentAt.title: Agenda notice sent at
agendaNoticeSentAt.description: When each member last received an agenda change notice for this meeting.
agendaNoticeSentAt.x-notes: A map of Nextcloud user id to date-time, written by AgendaService::notifyAgendaChanged(). A member who got a notice less than five minutes ago is not sent another; the agenda version is recorded either way.
